$comment: Country pop-up (Welcome Page, Figma 76:196; scope 2.3). ON for UAE visitors only (user decision 2 Oct 2026): Figma has the UAE version only; KSA / other countries wait for Pramod (add an entry under `countries`). Shown only on Global (EN + AR), only when the visitor's detected country (Cloudflare, functions/_middleware.ts -> ch_geo cookie) has an entry under `countries`. Figma has the UAE version only, so other countries see nothing. Per country: `text` = key in src/data/content/forms/welcome.<locale>.json, `map` / `flag` = image keys under src/assets, `buttons[].target` = the edition region saved in the ch_edition cookie (window.chooseEdition): another region = the SAME page in that region (bug 037, 7 Oct 2026: /hospitals -> /ae/hospitals; the edition home when the page does not exist there), the current region = the pop-up just closes. `text` = `aeOnGlobal` (labels that say what the buttons do: 'Go to UAE Website' / 'Stay on Global Website', bug 037) or `ae` (the Figma words 'Continue Here' / 'Go to Global Website', written for a visitor already on the UAE site). Closing with Esc counts as 'global' (the visitor stays where they are). `remember` = how long a choice is kept (the pop-up buttons AND the header region switch save it): 'forever' = cookie ch_edition for one year (bug 084, 9 Oct 2026: the choice must survive new tabs and browser restarts; replaces the 5 Oct 'tab' decision), 'session' = until the browser is closed, 'tab' = sessionStorage, back in every new tab or window, 'never' = on every page load. `fallbackCountry` = the version shown when the visitor's country is unknown (10 Oct 2026 later, user: back to 'AE' = every Global visitor sees the UAE pop-up, incl. staging without detection; the earlier 10 Oct '' = only visitors DETECTED in the UAE; detection = functions/_lib/geo.ts via middleware.ts on Vercel / functions/_middleware.ts on Cloudflare, ch_geo cookie) (the nginx QA staging has no Cloudflare, so every visitor is 'XX') or has no entry under `countries` (user decision 5 Oct 2026: the pop-up must appear whenever the site is opened, and only the UAE version exists in Figma; set it to '' to show nothing to those visitors, as before). `devCountry` = the country assumed on a local dev server (no Cloudflare header there) so the pop-up can be seen; ignored in production.
